name: cavemio-sheet
title: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from an edge and can be thrown back: drag it toward its edge and release speed decides whether it closes.

cavemio.usage:
import { Sheet } from "@/components/sheet";

<Sheet trigger={<button>Filters</button>} side="bottom" title="Filters">
  …
</Sheet>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Built on the native <dialog> (modal.ts, shared with the other modal surface): focus stays inside, the page is inert, Escape works, and it sits in the top layer.
- Drag writes transforms to the panel directly: no re-render per move.
- Reduced motion: it fades; drag still works.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Thrown, not just dragged
features.description: projectInertia decides with release velocity, so a short flick closes it.

features.title: Rubber band
features.description: Pulling the wrong way resists instead of stopping dead.

features.title: Three edges
features.description: right, left and bottom; the bottom one has a grip.

features.title: Native dialog
features.description: Focus trap, Escape and an inert page.

states.title: open
states.description: Slides in from its edge (460ms) as the page fades back.

states.title: drag
states.description: Follows the finger 1:1 after 6px of slop; the wrong way resists.

states.title: release
states.description: Projected past a third: it carries on out (300ms); otherwise it springs back (380ms).
